name: transcriptfetch
description: Transcripts of public YouTube, TikTok and Instagram videos, with AI transcription when a video has no captions.

interface.longDescription:
TranscriptFetch gives ChatGPT the transcript of public YouTube, TikTok and Instagram videos, so you can summarize a video, quote it, compare several, or research a topic across a whole channel without copying captions by hand.

Ask about a video and ChatGPT gets its full text, with timestamps unless you only need the words. When a video has no captions, as with most TikTok and Instagram posts, TranscriptFetch can transcribe the audio instead.

What ChatGPT can do with it:
- Get the transcript of a YouTube, TikTok or Instagram video, or of a direct audio or video file link.
- Search for videos on YouTube, TikTok or Instagram, with YouTube filters for upload date, length and captions.
- Find YouTube channels and playlists.
- List a YouTube channel's videos, Shorts or live streams, or a TikTok or Instagram profile's posts.
- List a YouTube channel's playlists, and the videos in a YouTube or TikTok playlist.
- Check your TranscriptFetch credit balance.

Every tool is read-only. It fetches public content and changes nothing in your accounts. Private, age-restricted and members-only videos are not available. You sign in to a TranscriptFetch account once, when you connect.
defaultPrompt: Summarize this YouTube video and quote the key moments: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw
Find three recent YouTube videos about AI agents and compare what they say.
List the five newest videos on Lex Fridman's YouTube channel.

positive.description: Get the transcript of a YouTube video and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches the transcript of the video and summarizes what is said, quoting it.

positive.prompt: Find three YouTube videos explaining how transformers work in machine learning, with links.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists three matching YouTube videos with their titles and links.

positive.prompt: What are the five most recent videos on the @lexfridman YouTube channel?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the channel's five newest uploads, newest first, with titles and links.

positive.description: List the videos in a playlist.
positive.prompt: List the videos in this playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLrAXtmErZgOeCZF6Q4NBW8AdxWUBhb6w4
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the videos in the playlist (Lex Fridman's Recent Videos) with titles and links.

positive.prompt: How many TranscriptFetch credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the connected account's remaining credits. The check itself costs nothing.

negative.description: An unrelated request: no TranscriptFetch tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the ocean.

negative.description: Downloading media is not supported: TranscriptFetch only provides transcripts, so ChatGPT should say it cannot download the video (it may offer the transcript instead).
negative.prompt: Download this YouTube video as an MP4 file: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw

negative.description: A link that is not a video: get_transcript returns a clear error that the link is not a supported video, ChatGPT relays it, and nothing is charged.

review.commerce_description: TranscriptFetch does not sell anything or take payment in ChatGPT. An account's credits are managed on transcriptfetch.com, and the plugin shows no prices, plans or checkout links.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: transcripts of YouTube, TikTok and Instagram videos and direct media links, AI transcription when there are no captions, video and channel search, channel, profile and playlist listings, and the credit balance.
